code: body { animation: omniscope-pulse 7s infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @keyframes omniscope-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.2); } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(170, 0, 255, 0.4); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(255, 0, 85, 0.6); } }

body { background: linear-gradient(270deg, #1a0033, #001a33, #33001a); background-size: 600% 600%; animation: ontoRelational 12s ease infinite; } @keyframes ontoRelational { 0%{background-position:0% 50%} 50%{background-position:100% 50%} 100%{background-position:0% 50%} } .message { border-left: 2px solid rgba(255, 0, 128, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 0, 128, 0.2); transition: all 0.3s ease; }
